 UA.NEWS

 October
 2026
 22:57
-->
 FC Porto footballer Oskar Pietuszewski was withdrawn from the squad for the match at the last minute. The headline of an Interia Sport article states that this happened during the warm-up. Portuguese media cited by the outlet reported a muscle injury to the player.
 Second consecutive start
 Pietuszewski was due to start for FC Porto for the second match in a row, but did not take the field. After returning to the club, he quickly earned a place in the team’s lineup.
 More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel Telegram .
 Previous muscle problems
 Before the start of the 2026/2027 season, Pietuszewski had already suffered a muscle injury that caused him to miss the start of the campaign. At the end of September, he returned to play and subsequently received an urgent call-up to the Poland national team.
 The footballer played little for the national team. According to Interia Sport, coach Jan Urban took a cautious approach to the young player’s health. The outlet also writes that this approach benefited the FC Porto coach after the player’s previous problems.
